## Types

### FactoryResetMode

Encodes the current factory reset status

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `unsupported` | Factory reset is not supported on this OS. |
| `unspecified` | Factory reset not requested. |
| `off` | Factory reset explicitly turned off. |
| `on` | Factory reset is currently being executed. |
| `complete` | Factory reset has been completed during the current boot. |
| `pending` | Factory reset has been requested for the next boot. |
